This coin's class is FACTORY, which carries about a 46% base-rate loss, and the brief shows the classic pattern: 100% bundle share, top-5 buyers holding 95%, a launch bot present, and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.019 in the first two minutes. memos.scout:
The brief has some real demand signals: 484 buyers and 151.7 SOL bought in the last 15 minutes, a 77% return over that window, a deep 438 SOL pool, and no airdrop dump seen. Price is only 0.08% off its 30-minute high, so momentum hasn't broken yet.

But the case for buying now is weak. The class is FACTORY, which carries the worst base rate (about -46% per trade). Bundle share is 100%, and the top 3 wallets account for all of the curve buying, which points to coordinated rather than organic demand. In the first two minutes after graduation, 95% of buys came from the top 5 buyers, a launch bot was present, and the sell-to-buy ratio was 0.019, meaning almost no one was selling into the pump. That pattern looks engineered: the apparent demand may be the same few wallets moving size, and it can vanish the moment they stop.

My honest read: there is no strong case for buying this coin now. The one defensible argument is that the 30-minute high hasn't been broken and buying pressure is still net positive, but that is outweighed by the factory classification, bundle concentration, and a round-trip cost of 1.4-5.1% on a $20 ticket. I'd skip.
memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: a coordinated distribution by the bundled top buyers. The class is FACTORY, and the curve data shows bundle_share 1.0, top3_share 1.0, and buyers 1.0 (the bundle may be the whole buyer set). The first 2 minutes after graduation saw 178 SOL of buying from 51 wallets, with the top 5 holding 95% of that buy volume, plus a launch bot. The return is +25.6x over 30 minutes, with a last-15-minute return of +77%. Wallets that cheap-entered at this scale are the classic exit liquidity, and with only 438 SOL of pool depth, a bundle sell would crater price faster than we could exit. The drawdown of 0.08% says nothing about the next hour. Recommend skip.
